run_f_gold: run f_gold to count elements needed to fill gaps in an array range
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets and print success count
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which sorts an array and counts missing elements between consecutive values
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that calculates missing elements to complete a numeric range
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to avoid mutating the input array by using a sorted copy
